description: Synthetic shape-only API vectors reuse existing public PS256 envelopes. They prove no current DB authorization, real service registration, human confirmation, owner identity, process exit or deployment. No private key, PHI/PII or live credential. source_sha256 freezes unchanged R4a and R4b wire inputs.
